ideas.title: Investigation into Minnesota Medicaid policy violations
ideas.description: Investigate the report that poor policy language may have cost $1.7B across 14 Medicaid services in Minnesota.
questions: What were the specific policy violations?
What are the implications for Medicaid beneficiaries?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover a significant pattern of negligence or incompetence in the management of Medicaid services in Minnesota.

ideas.title: Trump administration's Medicaid funding freeze
ideas.description: Investigate the Trump administration's attempts to freeze Medicaid funding and the impact on various states and organizations.
questions: What were the motivations behind the funding freeze?
What is the impact on Medicaid beneficiaries?
How have states and organizations responded?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover a broader pattern of attempts to withhold funding from certain projects or states.
